title: vanwykia remota

It is native to South Africa and has been used traditionally for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Vanwykia remota include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which have been attributed to its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, and prevent the growth of certain bacteria and fungi.
